newsitem.title: BELGIUM: EU schools ministers back action on child abuse.
newsitem.headline: EU schools ministers back action on child abuse.

text.p: European Union education ministers backed action to protect children on Thursday and called for teachers to play a role in countering paedophilia.

"To effectively protect children and counter paedophilia, EU education ministers consider that measures must be taken in a range of areas, at national, European and international level," ministers said after a regular meeting.
"Education systems, particularly teachers and schools, have an important role to play in protecting children generally and in helping to counter paedophilia," ministers said.
EU governments and the European Commission have been put under pressure to take action after months of revelations in Belgium about an extensive paedophile network.
